control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at TX-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on TX-9001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. TX-9001 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 October 2009 a near hit was recorded on TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
